To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HIV down regulates VDR through the recruitment of multiple epigenetic factors that form a repressor SNAIL complex on the VDR promoter.
HIV down regulates VDR in podocytes via a SNAIL repressor of chromatin remodeling enzymes that are involved in epigenetic regulation of VDR expression.
HIV infection down regulates VDR via the SNAIL repressive complex, and the combination of a VDR agonists with a HDACI can de-repress VDR in HIV infected podocytes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of HIV in podocyte injury.
the epigenetic modulation of podocyte vitamin D receptor ( VDR ) by HIV milieu.
the mechanism of down regulation of V DR and the role of epigenetics in HIV milieu.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

HIV milieu recruits multiple chromatin modifying enzymes to form a SNAIL repressor protein complex that represses VDR expression in podocytes and that the VDR down regulation is a key event in HIV-induced podocyte injury.

the HIV milieu enhances the formation of SNAIL repressor complexes that epigenetically down regulate VDR in podocytes, thereby promoting podocyte injury and progression of HIV-associated nephropathy (HIVAN).
the HIV milieu in podocytes down regulates VDR via SNAIL repressor that is recruited by multiple chromatin enzymes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HIV induces a SNAIL-dependent repressor complex that recruits multiple chromatin remodeling enzymes to down regulate VDR.
HIV milieu induces SNAIL expression that recruits HDAC1, mSin3A, DNMT1 and DNMT3b to VDR promoter to suppress VDR expression.
in HIV milieu, the SNAIL complex recruits chromatin modifying factors that epigenetically modulate VDR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the HIV milieu is conducive for epigenetic repression of VDR.
HIV milieu can modulate VDR expression through epigenetic factors and that VDR agonist and HDAC inhibitor can be useful in de-repress VDR.
epigenetic factors are involved in down regulating podocyte VDR in the HIV milieu.
